text.description_html:
First Impressions FII-SD-3400/12 12" Two Tone Contemporary Shower Door Pulls

This contemporary designed shower door pull is constructed of durable non rusting aluminum. Two Toned - The back flat portion of the pull is Satin Nickel and the front raised portion is Polished Chrome.

Also available: Smaller 9 Inch Contemporary Shower Door Pulls

Specifications of First Impressions SD-3400/12 Two Tone Contemporary Shower Door Pulls

  • Total Length: 12"
  • Mounting Center to Center: 8"
  • Pull Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Finish: Satin Nickel (bottom) with Polished Chrome (top)
  • Non Rusting Aluminum

Packaged with 2 door pulls and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
